canonical_project: NAVFAC Guam Communications Center Upgrades / Andersen AFB data center project (36th Communications Squadron)
notes: NAVFAC Pacific awarded a $289,762,614 firm-fixed-price contract (announced Sept 2025, official NAVFAC Pacific channel, A) for communications center upgrades in Guam. DCD reporting (B, per GU methodology baseline) described the tender as a two-story reinforced concrete communications center for the 36th Communications Squadron with generator building ('data center' characterization is media, B). May correspond to upgrading the existing Andersen AFB data center; keep approved until solicitation/construction confirms explicit data-center scope.
